description: This Java class 'AlarmsDeletionTaskProcessor' handles the processing of alarm deletion tasks within the Thingsboard platform, including batch deletion and individual alarm deletion, and logs the operations.

classes.name: AlarmsDeletionTaskProcessor
classes.description: Processor class for handling alarm deletion tasks, extending generic HousekeeperTaskProcessor.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes the alarm deletion task, either batching alarms for deletion or deleting specified alarms directly.

methods.name: getTaskType
methods.description: Returns the task type associated with this processor, which is DELETE_ALARMS.
